parsed.explanation: Universal visitor-facing exposures dominate: the 2025 passport regime (X markers stopped, M/F only per birth sex, reports of confiscation and stranded travelers, upheld Nov 2025), a national bar on federal single-sex facilities, and state/province facility bans covering roughly a third of units plus a documented trespass arrest (60 days' penalty, held 24h in men's ward). Foreign governments now issue travel advisories. Official hostility (counterterrorism framing, custody conversion-therapy policies) raises severity if detained. Weighing against: no offence of trans identity, functioning courts with active successful litigation, hate-crime and employment protections, no documented state violence against visitors, division violence at 4.8/100k floor with no denominator (background, per rule 16), and the division-specific care restrictions being largely resident-facing. Document friction plus patchy but real facility exclusion with partial remedy sits in Elevated Risk.
